reader.requirement: At --std 85, READ ... INTO on a relative file performs the READ, then (only if it succeeded) MOVEs the current record to identifier-1 by the MOVE rules. The current record's size comes from the RECORD clause (VII.3.8.4 GR12: under RECORD VARYING it is the length just read, and the move is a group move). identifier-1's subscripts are evaluated after the read, and the record stays in the record area too.

edition-consulted.switches: IntoPhraseRules.PhraseAt(DialectLevel) picks the MOVE rule's citation for diagnostics; CheckIntoReceiver uses the 1985 admissibility arm b (GR7) at 85

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel in MoveBinder.cs and BoundTree.cs IntoPhraseRules; the move kind (BoundCurrentRecord for VARYING, else BoundFieldOperand of the area) has no edition test
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf25_08 covers an elementary alphanumeric JUSTIFIED receiver, no move on 23, VARYING DEPENDING ON, and a subscript from the record; not covered: numeric and numeric-edited receivers from a single numeric 01, VARYING without DEPENDING, a receiver subscripted by the RELATIVE KEY that the READ itself sets, no move on at end

probes.expected: single 01 PIC 9(4): a numeric move to 9(6), an edited move to ZZ,ZZ9, and a group receiver padded with spaces
VARYING with no DEPENDING ON: the sender is the length just read (2, then 8), as a group move
W-E (TK), where TK is the RELATIVE KEY the READ sets (2, then 4): subscript evaluated after the read
no implied MOVE when the READ is unsuccessful

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR8  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8
OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR12  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR12

reader.notes: The INTO receiver is resolved at the store (ResolveReceivingAtStore), and the move is emitted inside the successful-status block after the RELATIVE KEY store. That is why a subscript naming the key sees the new RRN. p8into prints the same at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: Attack: no RECORD clause, 01s of 8 and 3 chars; r8cur.cob at 85 and 2023 (runs/r8cur-001/002) gives READ INTO W10 = [ABCZZZZZ  ] for a record written through the 3-char 01: the sender is the 8-char area, not 3 chars. Not a refutation: the file is fixed-length 8 by the documented implementor choice docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-147.md citing §1985:II.2.1.4.3 (OK, 'it is implementor defined whether fixed length or variable length records are obtained'), so the current record IS 8 characters and WRITE sent the whole area. GR7 refusal holds: READ INTO numeric N6 with four 01s refused COBOL1994 (runs/r6area-002). READ INTO group SAVE-B moves the whole record (r6area-003 R4). cites: OK §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR8; OK §1985:VIII.4.5.4 GR7.
